title: Text Document Editing with Undo and Redo
prompt:
Implement TextDocument(initial_text='') with insert(index, text), delete(start, end) -> str, undo() -> bool, redo() -> bool, and get_text() -> str. Indices are zero-based. insert places text before index; delete removes the half-open range [start, end) and returns the removed text. Empty inserts and empty deletions are no-ops and do not create history entries.

Every successful nonempty edit is undoable. undo reverses the latest edit and makes it redoable; redo reapplies the latest undone edit. A successful new edit after an undo clears all redo history. Return False when undo or redo has no available operation, and True otherwise. Reject invalid indices or non-string text with ValueError.

This is a practice reconstruction of the Notion report's unpublished class signature. Its nested-todo follow-up is deliberately out of scope for the plain-text operation-history contract.
